fact: Eswatini hosts 5 058 registered refugees and asylum seekers, and the Ministry of Home Affairs dispatched 70 refugee status permits and 77 machine-readable Convention Travel Documents in April-June 2026.
The Ministry of Home Affairs says refugee status permits let holders obtain personal identification numbers, national identity cards and access to government and financial services.
UNHCR's regional report says Eswatini has incorporated refugees and asylum-seekers into national registration systems.
